summary: Iteration 13 (FRONTEND-ONLY, 390x844). All 3 requested features PASS end-to-end on Expo web. (1) FRAME VAULT ✅ — as freak@test.com, tapping testID open-frame-vault opens the FRAME VAULT modal listing 8 unlocked frames. NOTE: E1's expected testID 'frame-Cobalt' DOES NOT EXIST — the modal uses the rank-key as testID (frame-Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced/Vanguard/Warrior/Boss/Elite/Freak). 'COBALT FRAME' is the display name of the Advanced-tier frame → testID is 'frame-Advanced'. Clicking frame-Advanced closes the modal and POSTs /api/profile/set-frame; after page reload the player card renders '◈ COBALT FRAME' (blue border replaces the crimson Freak border) — persistence confirmed. Re-opening the vault shows the ✓ active marker on the Advanced/Cobalt row. (2) JUDGE HISTORY ✅ — as elite@test.com (skool_verified), uploaded a real physique JPEG via the web gallery file input; The Judge returned overall 6.4/10 (S 6.2, C 6.5, Sz 6.6, P 4.8) in ~6s via /api/judge/submit. Tapping testID judge-view-mine renders MY SCORES with all four stat tiles: BEST 6.4, LATEST 6.4, TREND ▲0.0, JUDGED 1; the 'OVERALL SCORE OVER TIME' chart renders with a warning-yellow dot (polyline only renders for n>1 per code — correct); a history row testID hist-judge_988f78fbb00c shows date 8/18/2026, category summary 'S 6 · C 7 · Sz 7 · P 5', and numeric overall '6.4' in success color. (3) BOSS ALERT ✅ — cycled through all 6 tabs (index/workout/leaderboard/quests/community/profile) — the custom tab bar renders on every screen with all 6 items visible; no red screen or crash. testID boss-alert-dot is correctly ABSENT (no claimable boss quests on elite or freak). One earlier submission of /tmp/physique.jpg scored 0.0/10 and correctly did NOT populate history (backend filters unscored subs), which also validates the empty-state text 'No scored submissions yet. Submit a physique to start your history.' Console noise: textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents deprecation warnings still present (carried over from iterations 10–12, cosmetic).

ui_bugs.issue: E1's review request specified testID 'frame-Cobalt' but the code uses the rank-key as suffix: `testID={`frame-${fk}`}` where fk is from CARD_FRAMES (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced/Vanguard/Warrior/Boss/Elite/Freak). 'Cobalt' is the display name of the ADVANCED-tier frame, so the actual testID is 'frame-Advanced'. Not a functional bug — just a spec/testID naming mismatch that broke E1's expected selector. Either rename the testID to the frame's display name (e.g. frame-Cobalt) or update the spec/testID map so E1 and QA are aligned.

critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx pickFrame (line 60-63) correctly POSTs /api/profile/set-frame and calls refresh() before closing the modal. On web the shared `user` state is updated by refresh() but React may need a re-mount to reflect it in the memoized `frame` — after full reload the persisted active_frame is loaded from /api/me and the correct COBALT FRAME renders, so persistence is solid.

judge.tsx JudgeHistory (line 52-100) correctly renders empty state when hist.count===0, and stat tiles + SVG chart + hist rows when count>0. Polyline is guarded behind n>1 which is correct — a single submission just shows the dot, verified on-screen.

(tabs)/_layout.tsx CustomTabBar (line 17-57) polls /api/quests?scope=boss every 30s and only sets bossAlert when some quest has complete && !claimed — safe. testID `boss-alert-dot` is only rendered inside the quests tab item so it does not affect other tabs; no crash observed across all 6 tabs.
judge.tsx line 128 useEffect depends on canJudge, so history + feed + board reload after auth hydrates — good pattern (contrasts with the iteration-12 custom-program.tsx token race).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login button is 'ENTER'; login inputs are 2 plain <input>s. On web the gallery button opens a hidden file chooser — use page.expect_file_chooser() with a click on [data-testid=judge-gallery], or check for an existing input[type=file]. For a JUDGE submission to actually score >0 you need a real physique-like photo (e.g. Unsplash id 1571019614242-c5c5dee9f50b). Zero-score subs are filtered out of /api/judge/my-history so the trend view stays empty until at least one scored sub exists. Frame Vault testIDs use rank keys (frame-Beginner..frame-Freak), not frame display names — the ADVANCED-tier frame is 'COBALT FRAME' (testID frame-Advanced). freak@test.com starts with all 8 frames unlocked.
rca_of_issue: Cobalt selector mismatch: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx line 256 renders `<Pressable testID={`frame-${fk}`}...>` where fk is a rank key from CARD_FRAMES. The mapping in theme.ts pairs rank 'Advanced' with display name 'COBALT FRAME'. E1's review request referenced testID 'frame-Cobalt' — that testID does not exist. Reproduction: log in freak@test.com, tap open-frame-vault, run `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="frame-"]')` — returns frame-Beginner..frame-Freak, no frame-Cobalt. Mitigation options: (a) key the testID off the display name (`frame-${CARD_FRAMES[fk].name.split(' ')[0]}`), (b) leave code as-is and update the spec/QA reference to `frame-Advanced` for Cobalt.
